rules.title: Bridge doors must be distinct: equal locking and issuing doors are rejected
The bridge submitter must be one of the door accounts
Both bridge issues must be XRP or both IOU: mixed issues are rejected
SignatureReward must be non-negative XRP; MinAccountCreateAmount must be positive XRP on an XRP-XRP bridge
The issuing door must own the wrapped supply: the root account for XRP, the issue's issuer for IOU
The locking door cannot be the locking issue's own account
A duplicate bridge is rejected; the IOU issuer must exist and must not allow clawback; the door must hold the reserve
BridgeModify can change SignatureReward and MinAccountCreateAmount, or clear the minimum
A new bridge starts with claim ID 0, account-create count 0, account-claim count 0
Every attestation signature is verified over the canonical message
The signed message covers claim ID, amount, destination, source, reward account, chain direction, and bridge
A bad proof, invalid amounts, non-positive amount, or wrong-issue amount is rejected in preflight
The attested amount must be positive and its issue must match the source chain issue
The attesting key must belong to an account on the door's signer list
A master key attests only if not disabled; a regular key must match the account's regular key; a nonexistent account requires the key-derived account to match
Any account can submit an attestation signature

source.anchor: replace old attestation with new attestation

rules.title: A re-attestation from the same signer replaces the old attestation

source.anchor: Remove attestations that are not valid signers

rules.title: Attestations from accounts no longer in the signer list are erased before quorum is counted
Quorum is a weight sum over the door account's signer list
A door with no signer list yields tecXCHAIN_NO_SIGNERS_LIST
Weight at or above quorum finalizes the claim; below quorum returns tecXCHAIN_CLAIM_NO_QUORUM
Attestations match on amount and chain direction; the destination must also match for add-attestation flow, but not for an explicit claim
Quorum is evaluated on every new attestation arrival, against the attestation's own amount and destination subset
The bridge code sets no minimum witness count: a one-signer list is allowed, and a signer list holds at most 8 signers (32 with ExpandedSignerList)
Quorum must be above zero and no greater than the total signer weight; every signer weight must be positive

external.quote: If the signature list changes between the time the signature was submitted and the quorum is reached, the new signature set is used and some of the currently collected signatures may be removed.

rules.title: If the signer list changes between submission and quorum, the new set is used and some collected signatures may be removed
Claim IDs are a per-bridge counter: the first ID is 1, each new ID increments by one, and overflow returns tecINTERNAL
The claim ID is destroyed once funds move; a replayed claim finds no claim ID
Only the claim ID owner can claim it
The sending account must match the claim ID's OtherChainSource and the destination chain must match
At most 128 account-create claims may be outstanding: createCount must stay below claimCount + 128
Account-create claims are consumed strictly in order: the next claim must be claimCount + 1

source.anchor: Move past this claim id even if it fails

rules.title: A failed account-create transfer removes the claim so later claims are not blocked; a failed claim transfer keeps the claim
Account creation requires a minimum amount on XRP-XRP bridges; below the minimum is rejected
Account creation is only for XRP destination issues
The reward in a claim must match the bridge's SignatureReward
The reward pool is split equally among the matching attesters, rounding down when fixXChainRewardRounding is enabled

external.quote: The reward is only sent to accounts that have keys on the current list. A quorum of signers need to agree on the `SignatureReward`, the same way they need to agree on the other data. A single witness server can't provide an incorrect value for this in an attempt to collect a larger reward.

rules.title: The reward is only sent to accounts with keys on the current list; a quorum must agree on the SignatureReward
A door account cannot commit to itself
Bridge creation does not check that the door has a signer list or a disabled master key (absence: no such check in the creation path)
XChainCommit moves the committed funds to the door account; the committed amount must match a bridge issue (checked in preflight, E26)

external.quote: Anyone can run a witness server. However, the burden is on the participants of the issuing chain to evaluate the reliability of witness servers.

rules.title: Anyone can run a witness server; evaluating witness reliability is the issuing chain's burden
Exploit threshold: the minimum colluding witness weight that steals the door's funds equals the quorum
With an even witness count and majority quorum, the maximum safe collusion leaves the bridge degraded, not safe
Live cross-chain witness behaviour: attestation latency, witness independence, and key custody in production
